messages:
ryan_partnerships: Quick sync: prepping AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listings for Q2 partner launch. Need owners for: legal contract template, SKU/offer mapping, AMI/container artifacts, billing contact, staging test accounts. Ping owners below. TL;DR: want to validate billing flows by EOW and have staging listing up next week. :calendar:

maya_legal: I'll take the legal template + marketplace T&Cs review. Can you drop current sponsor contract? Also need to confirm data residency/PII clause for EU customers.

kevin_product: I'll own packaging tiers + SKU mapping. Sketching 3 SKUs: dev, team, enterprise. Want to confirm pricing bands before mapping to offer IDs.

olga_ops: I'll do AMI/container artifacts + staging deployment. Need VM sizes and allowed regions. Also need cloud team to generate test offer IDs.

devops-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.internal/checklists/marketplace-onboard — items added: AMI build, pricing sheet, legal sign-off, test entitlements.

ryan_partnerships: Kevin — can you put sample SKU mapping here? Also maya, timeline for legal sign-off?

kevin_product: Here is quick mapping (not final):
```
SKU_DEV = RDW-MKT-DEV-001
SKU_TEAM = RDW-MKT-TEAM-010
SKU_ENT = RDW-MKT-ENT-100
pricing_bands = ["$0-1k", "$1k-10k", "> $10k"]
```
I'll sync with finance on exact $ numbers today.

maya_legal: I can review by Thu EOD if finance gives numbers today. Note: Azure requires separate publisher agreement — will need sign-off from sales ops.

olga_ops: For AMI: we can build gcp image exported to marketplace image, AWS AMI, and Azure VM image. Need list of regions: us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1, europe-west1, asia-southeast1? Any objections?

kevin_product: Entitlements: do we need seat-based licensing or instance-based? For enterprise we'll include entitlement token exchange (license_key).

ryan_partnerships: Prefer entitlement token flow + metered billing for pay-as-you-go. For reserved capacity customers we’ll map to enterprise SKU.

maya_legal: Metered billing adds extra legal terms. We'll need description for metering endpoints and liability. I'll draft addendum.

olga_ops: On staging accounts: can infra spin up test offers? devops-bot can you create 3 test offers (dev/team/ent) with fake billing ids?

devops-bot: :white_check_mark: Created test offers in sandbox. IDs:
`offer-dev-1836sandbox`, `offer-team-1836sandbox`, `offer-ent-1836sandbox`. Added to checklist.

kevin_product: Great. I'll run quick end-to-end on GCP marketplace tomorrow morning and post results.

ryan_partnerships: :thumbsup: Final ask — can someone owner the listing screenshot + marketing blurb? Need marketing approved copy for the three clouds.

kevin_product: I'll draft the blurb and screenshots. Will ping marketing for final review.

maya_legal: One more: include escalation contacts for takedown and security issues in listing contact info.

olga_ops: Noted. I'll add security contact and support email to listing metadata.

ryan_partnerships: Thanks all. I'll collate actions and update the checklist. If we hit blockers ping me. Closing thread after staging validation.
